title: Slav Defense: Czech Variation
line: Black takes on c4, brings the bishop out, and pins the knight on c3.

steps.text: The Slav Defense. White brings both knights out.
Take the pawn on c4. White will have to spend moves to get it back.

also.e7e6: That is the Semi-Slav, also sound. This lesson takes the pawn.
also.a7a6: That is sound too. This lesson takes the pawn.

steps.after: If your pawn on b7 comes to b5 to hold the extra pawn, the pawn on a4 takes it.

steps.text: Bring the bishop out before you move the king pawn.
Move the pawn in front of your king one square to free your other bishop.
Bring the bishop out and pin the knight on c3 to the king.
steps.after: The knight cannot move while your bishop pins it, so it could not take back on e4.

steps.text: If White pushes the king pawn two squares now, while the knight on c3 is pinned, it loses a pawn.
Take the pawn on e4 with the bishop.

also.f6e4: That takes the pawn too. This lesson takes with the bishop.

steps.after: The pinned knight cannot take back. Black is a pawn up.

summary: Black takes the pawn, develops the bishop, then pins the knight so that White cannot push the king pawn.
